test_policy.notes: Northeastern is test-optional 'for the foreseeable future'; applicants who apply without scores are not penalized. If submitted, Northeastern super-scores and considers the better of SAT or ACT. All enrolling students must send final exam results (e.g. AP/IB/national exams).

requirements.notes: One teacher and one school counselor recommendation (1-2 extra optional). Mid-year report for Regular Decision and deferred applicants. Northeastern offers no alumni or on-campus interviews but evaluates optional third-party InitialView or Vericant video interviews (due Nov 15 for ED I, Dec 1 for EA, Jan 15 for ED II, Feb 1 for RD). International applicants must submit the Declaration and Certification of Finances. CSS Profile and FAFSA apply only to US citizens, permanent residents and eligible non-citizens seeking need-based aid. Creative portfolio encouraged for CAMD; NYC performing arts require audition.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Binding. Page lists month and day only (notification 'by January 1'); interpreted as the fall 2027 entry cycle.

deadlines.label: FAFSA/CSS Profile - Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: US citizens, permanent residents and eligible non-citizens only.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waiver if you will have completed 4 consecutive full-time academic years in high schools and universities where English is the primary language of instruction for all courses except foreign language courses; request through the Application Status Check. Northeastern may request proof of English proficiency from any applicant. Not accepted: IELTS Indicator, PTE Academic Online, TOEFL Essentials, TOEFL iBT Paper Test, TOEFL ITP.

english.notes: No minimum. Middle 50% of admitted students: 102 to 110 (exams on or before 2026-01-20); 'rec' is the lower end of that range.
No minimum. Middle 50%: 5.0 to 5.5 overall and subscores (exams on or after 2026-01-21); 'rec' is the lower end.
IELTS Academic. No minimum. Middle 50%: 7.5 to 8.0; 'rec' is the lower end.
PTE Academic. No minimum. Middle 50%: 79 to 86; 'rec' is the lower end.
No minimum. Middle 50%: 130 to 140; 'rec' is the lower end.
C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency. No minimum. Middle 50%: 195 to 202; 'rec' is the lower end.

aid.notes: International students are not eligible for need-based aid (institutional grants or federal aid). They are eligible for merit scholarships, which are extremely competitive and do not cover the full cost of attendance; the admission application serves as the scholarship application.

tier_notes.general: Admit rate is under 8% but the SAT median (1480) is below the ~1500+ of S-tier peers; high application volume. Rated A.
